visual_notes: limited flat lower-nose glazing, not greenhouse; no large turret. ~2.6 m flush internal bomb bay. Aft observer uses flush side blisters and retractable/socket defensive fit without changing OML

label: X-TP carrier-fighter research reference configuration

visual_notes: representative test-family OML, not a military designation. Small upward-folding outer tips optional on carrier-test airframes; no 1938 mass-fighter identity

canopy_cabin: single-seat Mitsubishi-style framed bubble/raised rear transparency
visual_notes: outer 0.55 m per wing folds upward at y=5.45 m; folded horizontal span ~10.90 m. Automatic outer slats + inboard Fowler/slotted flaps. 2x20 mm wing + 2x7.7 mm nose CG default; 4x20 growth is a later variant

canopy_cabin: single-seat forward canopy with long solid gun nose
visual_notes: major fold at y=3.50 m; outer panels fold upward, folded width ~7.0 m. Full leading-edge slats except nacelle interruptions; large inboard Fowler flaps; drooping ailerons. 4x20 mm nose target. JF lower-bypass cascade only; core exhaust never vectors

visual_notes: unarmed visual baseline; one vertical + paired oblique camera windows aft. Clean narrow nose/side exhausts and small chin intake; no fighter gun ports
